timeline.label: Q1 FY2027 10-Q: cash $8.9B, long-term debt $39.3B; balance sheet reflects FY2026 capital return and debt issuance
FY2026 10-K: revenue $41.5B, operating cash flow $15.0B, buybacks $12.6B, net income $7.46B
Continued share repurchase program; share count down ~4% YoY per FY2026 filings
Agentforce and AI agent platform launches accelerate CRM's generative-AI product cycle
FY2025 10-K: revenue $34.9B; operating margin recovery post cost discipline
Price increases on core CRM products signal pricing-power lever in enterprise base
Slack acquisition closed — collaboration layer embedded in Customer 360 platform
Tableau acquisition — analytics and BI embedded in platform strategy
Marc Benioff chair and CEO — founder-led capital allocation through cloud scale-up
IPO on NYSE — transition from growth SaaS to public compounder

industry.structure: Enterprise CRM and platform software is oligopolistic at the large-account tier (Salesforce, Microsoft Dynamics, Oracle) with fragmented point solutions in marketing automation and service. Switching costs and ecosystem depth create entry barriers.
industry.share_shift: Salesforce holds leading share in CRM but Microsoft bundles compete on price; AI agents may shift spend from seat expansion to consumption-based pricing.
industry.trend: Generative AI and agent workflows are embedding into sales and service software; data cloud and integration layers are the current competitive battleground; capital return via buybacks intensified in FY2026 alongside higher leverage.
